items.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: “Yeah, Marian, nice tunes.” And Hank O’Neill

ctx.x: Yes, a marvelous lady. Was this at the Hickory House you played or was that after that?

No it was after that. The Hickory House had closed I think at that point. We worked at a place called The Apartment. The first time I met Ruby Braff was there. He came and sat in with us. And we had a great time traveling around together and playing. It gave me confidence in it. And Bobby Hackett — I actually met Bobby Hackett and played with him at that time. She was doing a Christmas present to a friend, somebody, I forget now, in Europe and she wanted to send a tape. So Hackett came in and read her songs and…
recorded it, it was at the Fairchild House. And for me it was like — I’d just come to New York and I’m playing with Marian and playing with Bobby Hackett, and it was real exciting.
